core.headline: Four-bedroom 1930s semi-detached house in Sevenoaks
core.listing:
A four-bedroom 1930s semi-detached house on Oak Lane, extended and reconfigured to provide versatile family accommodation. The 2021 rear extension created a kitchen/family room measuring 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) with an island, bi-fold doors to the garden and underfloor heating; a log burner sits in the sitting room.

The sitting room measures 4.55m x 3.70m into bay (14'11" x 12'2" into bay) and opens to a separate dining room of 3.60m x 3.40m (11'10" x 11'2"). The former garage has been converted to a utility room and ground-floor shower room. Original stained-glass features remain in the front door and hall window.

The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10") and is served by a family bathroom. The fourth bedroom, a 2019 loft conversion with building regulations completion certificate, measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max) and has an en-suite shower room.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approx. 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Oak Lane lies approx. 0.8 miles from Sevenoaks station, with services to London Bridge in approx. 25 minutes. Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. Broadband: FTTP, Up to 900Mbps. Mobile signal: Good indoor and outdoor coverage. Parking: Driveway for two cars. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission.
